g2d000271af7_0_1016.text:
Definition: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the simulation of human intelligence processes by machines, especially computer systems.

Examples:
Smart assistants (Siri, Alexa)
Online translators
Recommendation systems
Robotic vacuum cleaners
Autonomous vehicles
Healthcare diagnostics

g2d0b021cd48_0_14.text:
1950: Alan Turing publishes his famous paper "Computing Machinery and Intelligence," which introduces the idea of the "Turing Test" as a way to evaluate machine intelligence.

1956: The term "artificial intelligence" is coined by John McCarthy at the Dartmouth Conference, which is considered the birth of AI as a field of study.

g2d0b021cd48_0_22.text:
1965: The first AI program, called ELIZA, is created by Joseph Weizenbaum at MIT. It simulates a conversation with a psychotherapist, though it has no real understanding of the conversation.
1972: The first intelligent industrial robot, the Famulus, is built in Germany.
1979: The Stanford Cart, a small robot controlled by AI, becomes the first to navigate itself successfully.

g2d0b021cd48_0_30.text:
1986: The first neural network-based AI system,NETtalk, is developed to allow computers to|understand human speech.

What is a Neural Network?
A type of artificial intelligence system that is loosely modeled after the human brain. Just like the brain is made up of interconnected neurons, a neural network is made up of interconnected nodes or units. Each node is a tiny computational machine that receives some input, does a simple operation on that input, and then passes the result on to other connected nodes. The weights of nodes is based on training/experience.

g2d0b021cd48_0_62.text: 1997: IBM's Deep Blue becomes the first computer program to defeat a world champion in a chess match, beating Garry Kasparov.

g2d0b021cd48_0_38.text:
2005: The DARPA Grand Challenge is won by Stanley, an autonomous robotic vehicle that navigated a 132-mile desert course.
2009: Google starts working on self-driving cars, which use AI to navigate roads and obey traffic laws.
2011: IBM's Watson becomes the first AI system to win the quiz show Jeopardy!, beating human champions.
2016: AlphaGo, an AI created by Google's DeepMind, defeats a world champion in the complex game of Go.

g2d0b021cd48_0_46.text:
November 2022: OpenAI's GPT-3 language model (ChatGPT) is released to the public, demonstrating remarkable abilities in natural language processing.
The world enters an AI revolution that continues since.

g2e6e0af32b7_0_10.text: Artificial Intelligence, interest over time (2004-2024), Google Trends

g2d0b021cd48_0_54.text:
Traditional Machine Learning: Rule-based systems, decision trees, support vector machines.

Deep Learning: Neural networks with multiple hidden layers, capable of learning complex patterns.

g2d000271af7_0_1023.text: Generative AI Revolution: programs and algorithms that use deep learning to create new text, images, audio, video, and other creative content per textual commands of the user.

g28f654a8dbd_0_1.text: Specialized in performing specific tasks, such as image recognition or language translation.

g28f654a8dbd_0_2.text: Capable of understanding, learning, and performing any intellectual task that a human can.

g2dc5db8370e_0_1.text: A type of AI that can understand, learn, and apply knowledge across a wide range of tasks, matching or exceeding human intelligence.

g28f654a8dbd_0_14.title: What is the role of Marketing in organizations?

g28f654a8dbd_0_15.text: What is the role of Marketing in organizations?

g28f654a8dbd_0_16.text:
Market Research and Analysis: Understanding customer personae, needs, preferences, and behaviors; analyze market trends and competitors; identify growth opportunities.
Marketing Strategy: Developing marketing strategies aligned with organizational goals and objectives.
Branding & Positioning: Building and managing the organization's brand identity, positioning, and messaging. (Employer Branding)
Company & Product Promotion: Creating and executing campaigns utilizing various channels such as advertising, digital marketing, and public relations to reach and engage prospects, customers, investors, and employees.

g28f654a8dbd_0_21.text:
Customer Acquisition and Lead Generation: Attracting new customers through targeted marketing initiatives, e.g. content marketing, social media marketing, and search engine optimization (SEO).
Sales Support and Enablement: Providing sales with marketing collateral and resources to engage prospects. Create and maintain websites, presentations, brochures, etc.
(Customer Retention, CRM)
Performance Measurement and Analytics: Monitoring and evaluating the effectiveness of marketing campaigns and initiatives. Optimize marketing efforts for continuous improvement.

g2db682be3fc_0_6.text:
Research:
Define a question > Research Google/Reports > Summarize > Presentation
Suggest questions > Research AI Chatbots > Get Summaries > Human challenge/smarts > Generate Presentations

Social Media / Blogs:
Think of ideas > Write posts > Find/source visuals > Post
Get idea suggestions > Generate post texts > Human review > Generate visuals > Post

Design process / Visuals:
Write a brief > Source a designer > Research for Inspiration > Drafts > Review > Select
Write a prompt > Use AI > Get inspiration / styles > Countless Drafts / Fixes fast > Select

g2db682be3fc_0_13.text:
Brochures / Presentation:
Write a brief > Write texts > Source a designer > (Design process) > Reviews > Final
Write a prompt > Generate texts > Generate visuals > Put together (or get a designer to put together, providing him/her with inspiration) > Review > Final

Video (WIP):
Write a brief > Source a producer > Texts > Source actors > Source visuals > Source music/effects > Reviews > Final
Write a prompt > Generate video > Review > Final

Analyze Data:
Get the data > Look at the data > Understand the data > Find patterns > Presentation
Get the data > Upload data to AI > Ask insights/questions > Get analysis > Generate Presentation > Human review
